# Project Design Context

Refreshed from project sources on 2026-09-11.

## Project

- Name: tutto-passa
- Product type: spoken language practice app
- Stack: nextjs, react, tailwind-v4
- Color mode: light
- Density: comfortable, phone first

## Sources

- Tokens: app/globals.css
- Components: components/ui.tsx, components/avatar.tsx, components/call-screen.tsx, app/ticket.tsx
- Assets: app/icon.svg
- Instructions: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, PRODUCT.md

## Components

- Preferred primitives: Button, buttonClass, Surface, Section, Eyebrow, Empty, Skeleton, Ticket
- Patterns: one raised sheet per screen; Italian in Newsreader with `lang="it"`; primary action pinned to the bottom of Home

- `--color-ground`: `oklch(0.975 0.012 85)`
- `--color-card`: `oklch(0.992 0.006 85)`

### Typography

- `--font-sans`: Figtree, for English help
- `--font-voice`: Newsreader, for Italian

## Constraints

### Must

- WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and full keyboard operation
- A calm alternative for every animation under prefers-reduced-motion
- Every number comes from real speech or real reviews

### Avoid

- Kids' game chrome: XP, gems, hearts, confetti
- Generic AI chatbot patterns: chat bubbles, sparkles, the word AI
- Corporate e-learning dashboards and progress bars for everything
- Dark mode by default, neon, glowing gradients

## Decisions

- 2026-09-08, main interface: Il Quaderno
- 2026-09-09, application shell and style guide: primitives in components/ui.tsx and a living style guide at /stile
- 2026-09-11, design pass: Ticket to Rome (ticket for today's call, phrases that turn green in the call, pinned call button, thumb-zone review buttons)
